item: SCENARIO A: Twilio recharged under current routing (9-10 call + code SMS; 5-8 push-only) - incremental usage
basis: estimate: urgency 9-10 alert events Oct 1-14 (15 events = 32.61 a month) x Jul 1-Aug 23 statement usage excluding rentals per urgency 9-10 event (USD 25.9845 / 47 events = USD 0.5529; calls unbilled, as on those statements)
notes: Priced per alert event, not per logged attempt. Production alert records (events with urgency 9-10 that got a push record; server extract to 2026-10-14 15:37 UTC) give 47 such events in Jul 1-Aug 23 (75 accepted calls and 82 SMS, about 1.6 calls and 1.7 SMS per event, including re-call rounds when articles joined an unacknowledged event and update SMS), 33 in Sep 15-30, 15 in Oct 1-14 and 48 in Sep 15-Oct 14 (61 dispatch rounds, so 13 escalation updates). The journal's 290 call and 290 SMS attempts rejected in Sep 15-Oct 14 (58 + 58 in October) overstate demand: on the dead account the code SMS never arrives, so no event is ever acknowledged, and a rejected call leaves no alert record, so the retry-interval guard in _execute_phone_call (which looks at earlier call records) never holds a retry back. Sep 15 alone logged 96 rejected calls while 4 new urgency 9-10 events arrived. Central = 15 / 14 x 30.44 = 32.61 events a month x 0.5529 = 18.0312. Low = quietest rolling 7 days in October (Oct 6-12, 7 events) = 30.44 x 0.5529 = 16.8291. High = Sep 15-Oct 14 pace (48 / 30 x 30.44 = 48.70 events a month) with calls billed at June's rate (Jul 1-Aug 23 USD 25.9845 + 3.87 + 1.29 = 31.1445 / 47 = 0.6626 per event) = 32.2737. The busiest rolling week (Sep 23-29, 19 events) would run at about USD 54.75 a month while it lasts. Cross-check with the simpler pricing of one call (USD 0.0717 a minute) + one code SMS (July average USD 0.3072) + TTS per event and one update SMS per escalation: Sep 15-Oct 14 gives USD 22.5566 a month, inside the range. This replaces the earlier USD 14.6476 (Jul 1-Aug 23 average, about 26.5 events a month). Rentals (USD 5.15) are already in the lines above, so the full monthly cost after a recharge is about USD 23.18 (18.03 + 5.15), up to about USD 37.42 at the high bound. Reactivation first absorbs the debt: USD 9.4924 until 2026-10-20, USD 10.6424 from 2026-10-21, USD 14.6424 from 2026-10-28.
